name: Shopify eCommerce
description: Displays a Shopify store within a Drupal site (products synced from Shopify).
project_description:
Ecommerce on Drupal doesn't have to be difficult. 

 This module integrates Shopify with your Drupal website. 

 Your Shopify products are synced to your Drupal site as Drupal entities. These product entities are fieldable, theme-able, and completely Drupalized. Shopify's clean and intuitive interfaces power your store's back office and Drupal is used for product display. Customers check out using Shopify's checkout workflow.

 Learn more about Shopify at Shopify.com 

 I've used Ubercart and Drupal Commerce quite a bit. This Shopify integration is by far the easiest commerce-enabled Drupal site I've made. - Justin Neel, Developer for http://heat.thermacell.com/ 

 
 
I've figured it out and got it running. Even with my very limited tech capability, it's functioning, which is a testament to your work.

 
 

 Ready to get started? 
 The first step is to sign up for a Shopify account .

 Want to get involved? 
 Submit a bug report or feature request to the issue queue. Connect on Drupal Slack in the #shopify channel.

 This module is not an official project of Shopify . 

 
 This module was originally developed by Bonify . Thank them for their efforts by using their Shopify affiliate link: http://shopify.com?ref=bonify .
